journal_lines: Creeper behind a tree. Backed up fast.
Spotted it before it spotted me. Barely.
Quiet and green. Made noise before it could.
It made the small sound. I made a smaller one, further away.
A thing built around a single regret, looking for someone to share it with.
Saw the leaves move before I saw the green. The leaves were generous about it.
Hissed once. Did not hiss again.
Its shadow on the wall was patient. The thing casting it, less so.
Quiet patrol of one, looking for company. Did not provide any.
Heard the fuse start. Stopped hearing it.
Stalked it through the brush, the way it would have stalked me.
